notes: Additive presentation-only successor above frozen V18. V19 consumes only normalized fields already delivered by Kyre Sports API: NCAA-owned team names/records/logos, exact sportsbook quotes, API-owned best_available_price, certified line/price sensitivity scenarios, Kyre model verdict/projection/drivers, recent form/history/environment, risk/flip modules, and freshness/audit metadata. It adds team identity marks throughout the hero, projection, matchup, recent-form, and why sections; exact-book consensus with best-price emphasis; model-vs-market edge decomposition; probability sensitivity; readable reliability; image fallback; and freshness chips. It does not alter CFB model math or sports_api/api/cfb_top_picks_page2_v1.py, does not add a direct external fetch route, does not average sportsbook lines, does not guess opening lines, does not convert null to zero, and preserves canonical sport=cfb&market=top-picks routing. SGO, ESPN, and ESPN BET remain forbidden in every request/fallback/enrichment path.
